question.:question/problem:
What are the dimensions of the matrix $A$, where
$A = \begin{bmatrix}-2 & 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 1 & 8 & -3 & 7\end{bmatrix}$?
question.:question/worked-solution: The matrix $A$ has $2$ rows and $4$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $2\times 4.$
